alt.en: A printed page of music headed "Down By The Old Mill Stream.", marked "Andante espressivo." and "Tell Taylor.", for voice and piano in G. A piano introduction marked "Slow." leads to the voice, with two verses under the notes: "My darl-ing I am dream-ing, of the days gone by" and "The old mill wheel is si-lent, and has fall-en down". At the foot: "British Copyright Secured." and "Copyright, 1910, by Tell Taylor."
alt.es: Una página impresa de música con el encabezado "Down By The Old Mill Stream.", marcada "Andante espressivo." y "Tell Taylor.", para voz y piano en Sol. Una introducción de piano marcada "Slow." lleva a la voz, con dos estrofas bajo las notas: "My darl-ing I am dream-ing, of the days gone by" y "The old mill wheel is si-lent, and has fall-en down". Al pie: "British Copyright Secured." y "Copyright, 1910, by Tell Taylor."

caption.en: The first page of music in the copy our arrangement is read from: the verse, Andante espressivo in G, under "Copyright, 1910, by Tell Taylor", with no other writer named.
caption.es: La primera página de música del ejemplar del que está tomado nuestro arreglo: la estrofa, Andante espressivo en Sol, bajo la línea "Copyright, 1910, by Tell Taylor", sin ningún otro autor nombrado.

alt.en: A hand-coloured postcard photograph of a still, wide river reflecting trees and a cloudy sky, with thick bushes on both banks and a field beyond the far bank. Red lettering at the top reads "Up the River from Riverside Park, Findlay, Ohio". No people are in the picture.
alt.es: Una fotografía de postal coloreada a mano de un río ancho y tranquilo que refleja los árboles y un cielo nublado, con matorrales espesos en las dos orillas y un prado más allá de la orilla opuesta. Arriba, unas letras rojas dicen "Up the River from Riverside Park, Findlay, Ohio". No hay personas en la imagen.

caption.en: The Blanchard River seen from Riverside Park in Findlay, Ohio, on a postcard mailed there in August 1910, the month the song was registered; Findlay holds that this river is the song's mill stream, and the park now has a marker that says so.
caption.es: El río Blanchard visto desde el Riverside Park de Findlay, en Ohio, en una postal enviada desde allí en agosto de 1910, el mes en que se registró la canción; Findlay sostiene que este río es el arroyo del molino de la canción, y hoy el parque tiene una placa que lo dice.

source: Up the River from Riverside Park, Findlay, Ohio, postcard (The Valentine & Sons' Publishing Co., Ltd., New York; printed in Great Britain; postmarked Findlay, 29 August 1910), front
licenceEvidence: Holder's rights field: "No copyright in the United States" (http://rightsstatements.org/vocab/NoC-US/1.0/). Our reasoning: published by 1910 (postmarked 29 August 1910), so public domain in the US; the card names no photographer (a publisher's view card, anonymous), so in the EU and Israel its term ran 70 years from publication and ended by 1980. Faithful scan of a flat card (see rights.md).

alt.en: A printed page of music for voice and piano, numbered 4, with the end of the chorus: "ging-ham too, It was there I knew, that you loved me true, You were six-teen, my vil-lage queen, by the old mill stream". "very slow" is printed over "You were six-" and "With the voice" in the piano part; pause signs stand over "teen" and after "queen", "rit." over "old", and the page ends with first and second endings and "D.C.".
alt.es: Una página impresa de música para voz y piano, con el número 4, con el final del estribillo: "ging-ham too, It was there I knew, that you loved me true, You were six-teen, my vil-lage queen, by the old mill stream". Sobre "You were six-" está impreso "very slow" y en la parte de piano "With the voice"; hay calderones sobre "teen" y después de "queen", "rit." sobre "old", y la página termina con primera y segunda casilla y "D.C.".

caption.en: The end of the waltz chorus as Taylor printed it: "very slow" on "You were six-", the piano told to follow "With the voice", and pauses on "teen" and "queen", the freedom our chorus keeps.
caption.es: El final del estribillo de vals tal como lo imprimió Taylor: "very slow" (muy lento) sobre "You were six-", el piano con la indicación "With the voice" (con la voz) y calderones en "teen" y "queen", la libertad que conserva nuestro estribillo.
